howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支复制 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器到 src/channels/、追加一行注册 import、安装固定版本的适配器包,再跑构建和注册测试;凭据环节会依次询问 access token、Phone Number ID 等值并写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你给 NanoClaw 接入官方 Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API 渠道时触发;可能发生在 /setup 流程中,或用 /manage-channels 把该渠道接到 agent group 时。

say.text: 帮我加上 WhatsApp Cloud 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 外发消息发出去了但收不到
say.note: 会检查开发模式允许名单和 24 小时窗口

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, adds its registration import, installs the pinned adapter package, then runs build and a registration test. Meta credentials are written to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you add the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw, during /setup, or when you run /manage-channels to wire the channel to an agent group.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs tests
Sets WEBHOOK_PORT for the shared webhook server

say_en.text: Outbound messages send but never arrive
say_en.note: Checks dev-mode allowlist and the 24-hour window
